msgs.t: Reminder: attachment reports are due Friday, 5pm.
Bound copy + soft copy. Logbook signed.
Late reports will not be marked.

slides.b: Every week you got signed is a paragraph. Start there, not with a blank page.

slides.h: The organisation in half a page.
slides.b: What they do, your department, who you reported to. No history lesson.

slides.h: What you did, week by week.
slides.b: Task, tool, one result. "Assisted with" tells them nothing.
Coordinators look for this. What went wrong, what you did, what changed.
Then one recommendation for the organisation and one for your department.

slides.h:
An attachment report
in Word. KES 5.
slides.b:
Tell Toso where you were and what you did. Get the finished report in Word or PDF.
Pay with M-Pesa. No card, no monthly bill.
